title: The wrong door
starting_code:
if left_door.locked:
    wizard.move_down(3)
    wizard.move_left(3)
    left_door.open()
    wizard.move_down(3)
    wizard.move_right(9)
else:
    wizard.move_down(3)
    wizard.move_right(3)
    right_door.open()
    wizard.move_down(3)
    wizard.move_right(3)
hints: My program always tries to open the locked door! It does the opposite of what it should.
Look at the `if` and `else` parts. The code under `if` should belong under `else`!
Swap the lines under `if` with the lines under `else`.
intro: Oh no! I wrote a program for when we come back through this room, and it walks straight to the locked door! I think I put the branches the wrong way round... Can you fix it?
outro: Thank you! I see now how to put the right lines in each branch.
learned: Now you know how to read a condition and see which branch runs.
